title: Pipeline validator ledger
description: The machine-readable definition of docs/PIPELINE-CONTRACT.md §24 — the validator's record of every decision, one row each (scripts/pipeline_validator_ledger.py, KIT-535). Append-only, written by one writer function. A ledger that cannot be read or does not validate means no approval.
$comment: FIELDS ONLY. No ticket, comment or pull request text, except `agent_says`: one plain line, marked as the agent's words. The rules that tie fields together (an approval needs all three layers to pass and its switch on; a merge row carries a head and a plan or piece row does not; one row per head) are enforced by the module's own checks, which this schema's keywords cannot say.

schema.description: The marker. A reader that does not know it treats the ledger as unreadable: no approval.

rows.description: One per decision, oldest first. Only ever added to.

verdict.description: A layer's verdict. `unsure` holds, as `fail` does. `not-run`: an earlier layer held, so this one was not asked.

at.description: When the writer added the row. The writer stamps it; a caller cannot.

subject.description: What was decided: a plan's approval, a piece starting, or a pull request merging.

ref.description: A ticket id for a plan or a piece; `owner/name#N` for a merge.

head.description: The pull request's head, in full, for a merge. Null for a plan or a piece.

layers.description: Each layer's verdict. An approval needs all three to pass.

evidence.description: Layer 2: checks, the review, the acceptance check, the merge state.

settings_on.description: The validator's switches that were on when it decided (the validator's settings).

size_limits.description: The size limits in force when it decided (the validator's settings).

agent_says.description: The agent's reason, in its own words: one plain line of at most 300 characters, nothing hidden. The code judges every character by its Unicode category; this pattern names the main hidden ranges. Null when the agent said nothing. Never an instruction to anyone.
